messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: latency.p99 > 1.5s for service=inference-hosted region=eu-west — triggered to eng-oncall
alex: Acked. Seeing p99 ~1.9s, p95 ~580ms. Error budget trending up.
dmitri: I’m on it, pulling traces now. Any customer errors?
maya-cs: A couple of customers reported slow responses for embeddings API, one timed out at 10s. CS triage flagged 2 high-priority accounts.
priya: FYI incident-bot notes quiet-window suppression active for some noisy alerts earlier, not this one (this one fired).
alex: Root traces show a lot of long tail on host-side decode step, GPU utilization normal but queue depth spiked.
anna-sre: Can we confirm KV cache hit-rate? If cache miss storms, tail latency climbs.
dmitri: KV cache hit-rate dropped from 96% -> 65% around spike start. Looks like cache TTL/eviction churn.
priya: Replaying metrics: batch sizes jumped briefly, autoscaler didn’t spin up due to recent cooldown.
alex: Quick mitigation: pin fallback route to smaller model-quantized instance for new requests, and enable prefix caching warmup. I’ll push the route change.
dmitri: Oncall note: I’m going to roll a model-variant swap to cpu-fallback for low-priority routes, will keep high-priority customers on current path.
anna-sre: Deploy command:
```
# route swap
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/route/swap -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","variant":"small-quant-v2","filter":"!customer:enterprise"}'
```
priya: That looks good. Also bump autoscaler min replicas for eu-west by +2 to absorb burst.
alex: Done model-route swap applied, confirmed new requests hitting quantized variant. Observing p99 drop to ~1.1s already.
incident-bot: Note: Pager update — escalation timer paused (ack by alex).
maya-cs: Communicated to affected accounts: we notified them of degraded latency and mitigations ETA ~10m.
anna-sre: Eviction logs show one host had a rogue eviction loop due to bad TTL config. I’m rolling a quick fix to TTL policy across cache pool.
dmitri: TTL fix applied to two nodes, cache hit-rate climbing to 88%. p99 now ~800ms.
priya: We should keep an eye on canary traffic for 15m to ensure no regression. Set a watch on p95/p99 and token queue depth.
oncall-rotation: Thanks team — if things stay stable we’ll close in 20m and hand off to next oncall. Please add a short postmortem note in incidents channel once stable.
alex: Confirming stable for 5m, traffic normalized, no further PD escalations. I’ll leave monitoring hook and follow-up tasks: investigate TTL churn root cause, autoscaler cooldown tuning, add caching warmup in deploy pipeline.
maya-cs: CS to follow up with customers and offer post-incident summary.
incident-bot: Pager resolved: alert cleared. Duration 00:08:17.
priya: Marking for post-incident follow-up. Handing off to night oncall in 10m. :white_check_mark:
